properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-ETTENDO lingi mu ggulu,
Basuuta nnyo Katonda;
Olw'ekiragiro kyo
Byonna lwe byatondebwa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
-Oluyimba-olukulu-ennyo
Lwayimbibwa mu ttumbi
-Olwa Kabaka-omuwere
Lwe yazaalibwa mu nsi

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Eggulu era n'ensi
Lwe birisangulibwa,
Walirabika-ebiggya,
Balimutendereza.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ffe fekka tusirike
Okutuusa lw'alijja?
Nedda,Ekkanisa ye
Ejja kutendereza.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Abatukuvu bonna,
Balijaguza ddala;
Batandikira mu nsi
Ne mu ggulu basuuta.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ennyimba ez'ettendo,
Zikusuute,Kitaffe;
Naawe Yesu Omwana,
N'Omwoyo-Omutukuvu.
